title: Iron Legion battle-flow rules (content/rules/battle_flow.json5)
description: Engine tunables for battle phases, timers and results (Simulation Spec 12 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

time_limit_ticks.description: Default battle timer when the setup gives none (SIM-FLOW-012).

fled_return_fraction.description: Fraction of fled soldiers that return to a losing side (SIM-FLOW-018).

timeout_winner.description: Who wins when the timer expires (SIM-FLOW-013).

exp_per_kill.description: Experience per kill credited to a regiment (SIM-FLOW-018).

loot_per_enemy_killed.description: Loot per enemy soldier killed, to the winner (SIM-FLOW-018).
